name: motion-lottie-read
title: Lottie reader
description: A Lottie file's keyframes read as written: frame rate, in and out points, size, layers, markers, and each transform property's keys with their values, holds and bezier handles; a property's value at t with the file's own curves; shapes, masks, expressions, effects and any field not read listed as unsupported, never dropped; and a tool that writes the declared keys, samples at a given frame rate and what is not read as reference tracks
